title: Iwasawa-Type Spectral Resultant Growth Laws for Grover Walks on Graph Towers
summary: Let $X_0\leftarrow X_1\leftarrow\cdots$ be a $\mathbb Z_p^d$-tower of finite graphs, and let $U_n$ be the Grover transition matrix on $X_n$. We study Iwasawa-type $p$-adic growth laws for the polynomial spectral quantities \[ \det P(U_n), \] where $P(A)$ is a monic polynomial. The basic object is the spectral resultant \[ \mathcal R_{X,P}(T)=\operatorname{Res}_A(\mathcal F_X(A,T),P(A)), \] where $\mathcal F_X(A,T)$ is the universal Grover--Ihara spectral polynomial of the tower.
